$comment: Reviewable exemptions for scripts/check-design-tokens.mjs. Every entry needs a reason; the checker refuses to run without one. exemptPaths: files where a rule (or every rule, "*") does not apply. exemptMatches: a rule does not apply to text matching the regex (optionally limited to paths). deadTokenIgnore: @theme tokens that are intentionally unused. One-off lines are exempted in the source instead, with `// ds-exception: <reason>` or `{/* ds-exception: <reason> */}` on the same line or on a comment-only line directly above. `proposed` is NOT applied: it lists files that look like they need an exemption, for a human to promote into exemptPaths.

exemptPaths.reason: §12: the company deck is a fixed 1600 x 900 slide canvas in real pixels
§12: event page templates carry their own type and palette, scoped to --e-*
§12: event page templates (EventTemplate, PreviewFrame) carry their own type and palette, scoped to --e-*
docs/product-page.md: public product pages carry their own palette and type, scoped to --pg-* (page/theme.ts); the shared values live in the .pg-* classes in globals.css
§12: public event pages render the event templates
§12: print pages use physical measurements (paper, thermal rolls, tickets)
§12: chart palettes (--chart-*, --heat-*) are the one place hues outside the semantic set are allowed
§12: the storefront's venue accent (--sf-*) is computed per venue for contrast
§12: seed data may hold operator-chosen hex category colours
§12: the data layer may hold operator-chosen hex category colours
PWA manifest colours must be literal hex; there is no CSS variable to point at
<meta name=theme-color> in the viewport export must be literal hex
keeps <meta name=theme-color> in step with the in-app theme; literal hex by necessity
a QR code must be pure black on pure white to scan, in every theme
§12 operator-chosen category colours: seat-layout templates seed the seat category colours

exemptMatches.reason: §12: the seat plan's 9px seat labels (each seat carries its full name in a title)

deadTokenIgnore.reason: §2 layer A: the primitive palette scales are kept complete so any step is available; components use the semantic layer
